messages.subject: Is Rattle package available in Debian repository?
parts:
Hi,

Is Rattle R package available in Debian repository or only in r-cran? I tried to find it in Debian but I can't. If it's not available in Debian, do you think that it is interesting?

Thanks!

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Is Rattle package available in Debian repository?
parts:
Debian and Ubuntu provide by default only the base R packages.

The majority are packaged for Debian and Ubuntu from CRAN by Michael Rutter

On Ubuntu, for example, add this to /etc/apt/sources:

deb http://ppa.launchpad.net/marutter/c2d4u/ubuntu trusty main

The actual package is:

http://ppa.launchpad.net/marutter/c2d4u/ubuntu/pool/main/r/rattle/r-cran-rattle_3.3.0-1cran1ppa0trusty0_all.deb


Graham Williams
http://togaware.com
